title: Implement Process section variants (process-steps, process-timeline)
description: Implement two Process section variants showing how the business works. process-steps shows numbered cards in a horizontal row. process-timeline shows a vertical timeline with alternating left/right content.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: ProcessContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Each step renders step number, title, and description
process-steps has connecting arrows between steps on desktop
process-timeline has a vertical line with alternating left/right items on desktop
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Headline + horizontal flex row (wrap on mobile). Each step: circle with step number (--color-primary background), title, description below. Arrow connector between steps using CSS (::after pseudo-element or a simple chevron icon).

Vertical layout. Center line using CSS border. Steps alternate left/right on desktop, all left on mobile. Each step: numbered circle on the line, content card beside it. Date/step number inside the circle.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify step numbers are correct, content is legible, connecting line/arrows are visible.
